artifact.summary: Implements eq_5 for a small binary RBM: a unitary that maps |0...0> to the Gibbs-state encoding sum_{v,h} sqrt(P(v,h))|v>|h>. The energy (eq_1) and Gibbs weights (eq_2) are evaluated classically from the instance parameters W, b, d. The state is built with a standard binary tree of multi-controlled Ry rotations, so every amplitude is non-negative and no phases are needed. This is a classical-compute state-preparation circuit, not the paper's quantum training algorithm.
register_layout: qubit 0..n_v-1: visible units v_0..v_{n_v-1} (qubit i = v_i, qubit 0 least significant)
qubit n_v..n_v+n_h-1: hidden units h_0..h_{n_h-1} (qubit n_v+j = h_j)
Example: q0=v0, q1=v1, q2=h0, q3=h1; basis index x = v0 + 2 v1 + 4 h0 + 8 h1; no ancillas
Encoding: computational basis, amplitude of |x> = sqrt(P(v,h)); intended input |0...0>

equation_mapping.explanation: RBM energy computed classically for every basis configuration from W, b, d.
Gibbs probabilities computed classically; the shift by E.min() cancels in the normalization and only aids numerical stability.
Log-likelihood objective is not part of the circuit; it is context for why the model distribution is needed.
Gradient is classical post-processing from samples and is not implemented. The circuit only prepares the state whose measurement would give the model term.
Prepares sum sqrt(P(v,h))|v>|h> from |0...0> using controlled Ry rotations whose angles come from marginal probabilities.

specification_changes.change: The Gibbs-state encoding is realized as an explicit state-preparation unitary from |0...0> with classically computed rotation angles. This is not a quantum Gibbs-sampling or paper-specific algorithm.
specification_changes.reason: The abstract gives no preparation method. A generic exact amplitude-encoding tree is the only defensible way to realize eq_5 with standard gates.

specification_changes.change: The energy and Gibbs weights are evaluated classically at build time, so the circuit angles depend on the full distribution (including Z).
specification_changes.reason: eq_5 needs the amplitudes sqrt(P). A circuit without classical knowledge of P would require the unspecified quantum method.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed: total qubits n_v+n_h capped at 8, below the global cap of 12. Measurement, sampling, gradient estimation and training are excluded.
specification_changes.reason: The multi-controlled tree needs 2^n-1 gates, so a cap of 8 keeps it practical. Measurement and training are outside an operation-only module.

assumptions: Visible unit i is qubit i and hidden unit j is qubit n_v+j
Parameters are bounded to |entries| <= 50 and must be finite
unresolved_issues: The paper's actual quantum training algorithm, state preparation and gradient estimation are not specified in the abstract and are not implemented
The state-preparation cost is exponential in n_v+n_h, so it offers no speedup
The full Boltzmann machine and multi-layer models are not covered
The data-dependent (clamped visible) term of the gradient is not implemented

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
